cards.label: 02 · Equip

cards.text: Compact AI machines, AI workstations or server racks, installed at your site with the models, security and monitoring, or hosted on our servers.

cards.label: 03 · Create and build

Even with the best cameras and huge storage, nobody watches hundreds or thousands of hours of video. Our AIs do, in real time. They spot suspicious behaviour, alert you according to your instructions and document every event.

Discover AI surveillance

translation.title: At your site. Or at ours.
translation.body:
AI is sovereign when you know where it runs, who can access it and where your data goes, and you can leave. We install it on your servers, or we host it on ours, in Quebec. Either way, your data stays yours.

Installed at your site · Hosted with us · Our approach · Your data · Our guides

blocks.role: Méthode : consultation, installation, exploitation et soutien.

cards.title: Consultation.
cards.text: We start from your problem, your tools and your rules. You receive a written proposal and estimate.

cards.title: Installation.
cards.text: We install the system at your site or on our servers, connect it to your tools and put it to the test with your team.

cards.title: Operation and support.
cards.text: We monitor it, improve it and stay reachable. Your team learns to use it and oversee it.

blocks.role: Les produits présentés comme un ensemble ouvert depuis le même compte, chacun avec son état réel en étiquette.

translation.title: A suite, not a pile.
translation.intro: Every product serves the same idea: AI that works for you, with access, budgets and logs you control. All of them open from the same account, and each label states the product's real status.

cards.title: Nexora WorkStudio.
cards.label: Available
cards.text:
Design, connect and run agents (software that carries out a task with the tools you allow) and workflows (automated sequences of tasks), in one place and in plain language. A step can wait for a person's approval before acting.
Status: available, meaning delivered and verified on our test server; no client result is claimed. It opens from “My tools” as long as you have a credit left. Demonstration on request.

cards.title: Nexora Code.
cards.label: Coming soon
cards.text:
A coding agent that understands, changes and tests your code, in an environment hosted on our servers: nothing to install on your computer. It is planned to work with Claude Code and Codex plugins.
Status: coming soon, no date. The tool is designed to be free; whatever it asks a model to do uses credits.

cards.title: Nexora RAG.
cards.label: Coming soon
cards.text:
Your documents become a knowledge base that AI queries, with sources. You create it in one click and connect it to your tools with an API key. You will pay for the storage it uses and for the tokens that index your documents and rank the answers (embedding and rerank), in credits.
Status: coming soon, no date.

cards.title: Models and API.
cards.label: Prices coming
cards.text:
An API (the door through which other software calls a service) gives access to several AI models, the engines that produce the answers, in the OpenAI format, a calling format many tools already understand. Every request uses credits, at actual cost.
Status: the catalogue can be browsed, but its prices are development prices and sales are not open.

cards.title: Hosted agents.
cards.label: Prices coming
cards.text:
The agents you publish in WorkStudio, callable by API with your own key, at the actual cost of each run in credits, under the same limits as everything else.
Status: calling by API exists in WorkStudio; the online catalogue is in preparation.

cards.title: Nexora Croissance.
cards.label: Early access
cards.text:
A website tailored to your trade with free web hosting (conditions on the page), search optimization, your Google and Microsoft ads, your social networks and market analysis: marketing run by AI and approved by you.
Status: early access, on request. No guarantee of results.

cards.title: Nexora Vision.
cards.label: Pilot project
cards.text:
AI video analytics that keeps your footage on your site, with no facial recognition.
Status: pilot project by invitation. No installation exists yet.

cards.title: VPS in Quebec.
cards.label: In preparation
cards.text:
A virtual private server (VPS) is a server rented for you alone. We are preparing offers hosted in Quebec, with an AI application installed of your choice.
Status: in preparation; online ordering is not open.

cards.title: The software suite.
cards.label: No date

Nexora Corpus to prepare your documents and data, and the Quanta and Helix models.
Status: no availability or date is announced at this stage.

blocks.role: FAQ : objections du rapport 06 §8.4, questions de la vague 2 et du modèle à crédits ; réponses vraies seulement, autonomes et citables.

items.question: Does my data leave Quebec?
items.answer: It depends on the deployment mode and the models you choose, and we write it down before we start. On your premises, your data stays on your server. With us, it stays in Quebec, backups included. In both cases, the only exits are the ones we list with you before going live: updates, licences and, if you turn one on, an external model. On the credits platform, each model shows where it is hosted, and the gateway keeps only usage metadata, never the content of your requests. We only write “no data leaves” if we have verified it on your setup.

items.question: Do you train your models with our data?
items.answer: Never. We do not use your data, documents, prompts or outputs to train or fine-tune any model, ours or a third party's, and we put it in the contract.

items.question: Do you sell our data?
items.answer: Never. We do not sell, rent, exchange or share for advertising purposes any data entrusted to us.

items.question: Is it really simple to use?
items.answer: That is the goal of the whole tool. You describe in plain language what you want to automate, an assistant prepares the workflow, you review it, try it step by step, then launch it. We install the system, run it with you and train your team in use and supervision, not in technology.

items.question: We have no technical staff.
items.answer: That is not an obstacle. We install the system, run it with you and keep it evolving; your team's training covers use and supervision, not technology.

items.question: What happens if we stop?
items.answer: You leave with your documents, configurations and workflows: export is provided for in the contract from the start, not negotiated at the end.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: There is no public price yet. Two things are paid for. Support (assessment, installation, configuration): a written estimate follows the assessment and says what is included and what is not. Use of the platform: in credits, because anything that calls an AI model uses them; a plan gives you credits and storage every month, otherwise you top up. Platform prices will appear on the Pricing page once they are published.

items.question: What happens when I run out of credits?
items.answer: Calls to models stop: the API returns a payment error and the message points you to top-ups and plans. As soon as your balance is above zero, you pick up where you left off. A zero balance erases neither your documents nor your settings; how long data is kept after a cancellation is not decided yet.

items.question: Do my credits expire?
items.answer: It depends on where they come from. Plan credits expire at the end of the period they were granted for, and they are used first. Top-up credits do not expire. On a yearly plan, credits are granted one twelfth per month.

items.question: What is free, and what uses credits?
items.answer: Anything that calls an AI model uses credits: an API request, an agent, an automation that reads or writes. Nexora tools that call no model use none, and the model catalogue with its detail pages can be browsed without an account. Nexora Code is designed to be free, but it is not shipped yet. Storage is counted separately: it comes with the plan.

items.question: Where is my data on the credits platform?
items.answer: The documents and files you keep with Nexora AI count toward your plan's storage, per organization. The model gateway keeps only usage metadata (model, tokens, cost, duration), never the content of your requests or of the answers. Each model's page states where it is hosted and its provider's data policy. Your data is never used to train a model.

items.question: Can I subscribe or top up right now?
items.answer: Not yet. Sales are not open: accounts and payments only work in test mode and no price is published. Plans will appear on the Pricing page once they are published. Until then, you can request a WorkStudio demonstration or describe your need.

items.question: Will AI replace my employees?
items.answer: Our systems take over repetitive tasks; the decision stays with a person. A workflow can stop for an approval before acting, and a log keeps track of what was done.

items.question: Why not a consumer assistant?
items.answer: A consumer assistant answers general questions well. What Nexora AI adds: the choice of where your requests are processed, your own documents as the basis for answers, links with your software, approvals and a log. The right choice depends on what you want to do with it.

items.question: Do we need a powerful server?
items.answer: It depends on the case. At our site, you buy no server. At yours, we size the hardware to your uses: number of users, volume of documents, chosen model. The assessment answers this before any purchase.

items.question: What is an AI agent?
items.answer: Software that carries out a task for you, with the tools and documents you allow it, and that asks for your approval before an important action.
